fields.title: PBO effective ply strength
fields.finding: The 10 m least root requires about 5.343 GPa effective ply strength; 60% of yarn strength does not close this radius even with the other endpoints.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure biaxial crossply strength, construction efficiency, seams, attachments and sustained load.

qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration.
